'''Fortune''' is an [[enchantment]] for mining tools that increases block drops. In [[Matcha Flavoured]] its maximum level is I; higher Fortune comes only from [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] tools, whose intrinsic works as Fortune up to level III.

== Obtaining ==
* The [[Prayer of Midas]], a crafted [[blessing]], stores Fortune I with Looting III.
* Random enchanted books and trial chamber vaults. Because the maximum level is I, no book can hold more.

== Behavior ==
Fortune works as vanilla Fortune I. Its maximum level is lowered from III to I, so it cannot be raised by combining books in an [[anvil]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/enchantment/fortune.json}}</ref> The pack adds the electrum tool intrinsic to the same exclusive set as Fortune and Silk Touch, so a tool can have only one of the three.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/enchantment/exclusive_set/mining.json}}</ref> The pack's block loot tables check for both Fortune and the electrum intrinsic. One table gets this wrong in 1.12.2-beta: when [[Native Gold|native gold]] drops raw gold, it applies the Fortune bonus twice and ignores the electrum intrinsic, so a Fortune pickaxe gets more raw gold there than from native deepslate gold, and an electrum pickaxe gets no bonus.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/gold_ore.json}}</ref> See [[Known bugs]].

Fortune has no effect on [[spawner]]s: each gives exactly one [[Divine Fragment]].

Its anvil cost multiplier is 1, down from 4.
